**Truthammer — 3 October 2026**
**A most inhospitable shelter**

On his turn, Dain casts Stinking Cloud, filling the Leaky Tent with horrid gas. His new tent guest missed him twice; now the shelter has acquired an even worse atmosphere.

Dain is concentrating on the cloud, up to 1 minute. The gas heavily obscures its area and can affect allies too. Dain, Harry and the beast were last confirmed inside; saving throws and reactions are still unreported. Dain remains at 28 HP.
